intro: Part 3: productivity and responsibility. Compare the two clues and distinguish what the text says from what it only seems to suggest.

texto: A text on work technology may present productivity as a goal and employment as an uncertain effect. Pay attention to expressions of probability and to who bears the cost of the transition.
